description: Free. Get the transcript of a video that is completed in one of your collections. Maps to GET /v1/videos/{youtubeId}/transcript. `collection_id` is required with an API key; with the collection's `ct_` token as the bearer it defaults to the token's collection. `format` is json (segments with timestamps, default) or text (one `[H:MM:SS] text` line per segment). 404 when the video is not completed in that collection, or the transcript predates the transcript cache. Prices are the service defaults; `quote` returns the exact price.

collection_id.description: Collection the video is completed in (required with an API key).

youtube_id.description: The 11-character YouTube video id, e.g. dQw4w9WgXcQ.

name: get_transcript
title: Get a video's transcript
